title: Conair Recalls BabylissPro Compact Hair Dryers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The spinning fan within the hair dryer can break apart, striking the hair dryer's plastic shell. This causes the plastic to shatter, creating a laceration hazard. Units: About 291,000.

title: Girls' Vests with Drawstrings Recalled by MIM-PI USA Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 80.

title: C&T International/Sorelle Recalls Cribs Due to Strangulation and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The cribs' drop-side hardware can disengage from the tracks, causing the drop side to detach from the crib. title: Bicycles Recalled by Nirve Sports Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle stem on the handlebars can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a risk of serious fall and injury. Units: About 725 units: Red Star 100, Skulls 285 and Cannibal Chopper 340.

title: Klean Kanteen Recalls Water Bottle Spouts Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The water bottle spouts can break or crack, posing a choking hazard to children and adults. Units: About 1.2 million in the United States and 102,000 in Canada.

title: Roberta Roller Rabbit Recalls Children's Kimono Robes, Lounge and Slumber Short Sets Due To Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The recalled sleepwear fails to meet the federal children's sleepwear flammability standard, posing a burn hazard to children. Units: About 9,200.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The shock absorber mount can break and the shock absorber can make contact with the wheel spokes, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,350.

title: Blair Recalls to Repair Roman Shades Due to Risk of Strangulation
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. Units: About 1,700.

title: JD Fine & Company Recalls Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hooded sweatshirts have a drawstring at the neck which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,700.

title: Chocolate Soup Recalls Children's Hooded Sweatshirt Sets with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood that can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 70.

title: HP Expands Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 54,000 (70,000 units were previously recalled in May 2009).

title: Target Recalls Storage Trunks Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The lid of the trunk can drop suddenly when released, posing a strangulation hazard to small children opening or reaching into the trunks. Units: About 350,000.

title: Walmart Recalls General Electric® Coffee Makers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The coffee maker can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 900,000.

title: Primal Vantage Expands Recall of Plastic Tree Steps Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic portion of the step can break, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 40,000.

title: Children's Giraffe Blanket Recalled by Rashti & Rashti Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target Stores
summary: The balls on top of the giraffe's horns can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 44,000.

title: Children's Deaths Prompt Recall of Toy Dart Gun Sets Sold Exclusively at Family Dollar Stores
summary: If a child places the soft, pliable plastic toy dart in his/her mouth, the toy can be inhaled into the throat and prevent the child from breathing. Units: 1.8 million.

title: Mall of America Recalls Plush Toy Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Young children can remove and ingest the squirrel's nose, which poses a choking hazard. Units: About 1200 produced, 11 sold.

title: Children's Sweatshirts Recalled by Tommy Hilfiger U.S.A. Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The sweatshirts fail to meet federal flammability standards for wearing apparel, posing a risk of burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 400 in the U.S., and 1,300 in Canada.

title: Junk Food Clothing Co. Recalls Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hooded sweatshirts have a drawstring at the neck which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 24,000.

title: Niner Bikes Recalls Bicycle Frame Due to Crash Hazard
summary: A welding deficiency can cause the bicycle frames to crack along the welds of the front triangle of the bicycle. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 750.

title: The Children's Place Recalls Denim Shorts Due to Choking Hazard; Metal Snaps Could Detach
summary: The denim shorts' metal snaps could detach from the shorts, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 29,000.

title: Remote-Controlled Helicopters Recalled by Imagine Nation Books Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The rechargeable battery inside the helicopters can overheat, igniting the helicopter and posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: 46000.

title: Rome Snowboards Recalls Bindings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The snowboard binding's base plate can break at cold temperatures, posing a fall hazard to snowboarders. Units: About 2,900 in the United States and 220 in Canada.

title: Step2® Recalls to Repair Riding Toys Due to Risk of Injury
summary: A pin attaching to the yellow knob on the handle of the buggy can loosen, causing the handle to detach from the buggy. This poses a serious risk of injury to young children. Units: About 2.5 million.

title: Claire's Recalls Children's Metal Charm Bracelets Due to High Levels of Cadmium
summary: The heart lock charms attached to the bracelets contain high levels of cadmium. Cadmium is toxic if ingested by children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 19,000.

title: Basketball-Shaped Chair and Ottoman Sets Recalled by Colleen Karis Designs Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard; Sold at HomeGoods Stores
summary: Surface paints on the lettering on both sides of the basketball chair could contain excessive levels of lead which is a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 380.

title: Boys' Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by Hind Fashions Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Burlington Coat Factory
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 200.

title: Buckyballs High Powered Magnets Sets Recalled by Maxfield and Oberton Due to Violation of Federal Toy Standard
summary: The high powered magnets sets were labeled "Ages 13+" and do not meet the mandatory toy standard F963-08 (effective August 17, 2009) which requires that such powerful magnets are not sold for children under 14. title: Children's Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by Lollytogs Due to Strangulation and Entanglement Hazards
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood and the vests have a drawstring through the waist which can pose strangulation and entanglement hazards to young children. Units: About 23,000.

title: Cost Plus Inc. Recalls Tea Glasses Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The Moroccan tea glasses contain excessive levels of lead in the exterior coloring. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 14,000.

title: Hoover Recalls Upright Vacuum Cleaners Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The power cord is not properly routed or securely seated in the cord rewind assembly allowing the power cord to be pulled loose. This poses fire and shock hazards. Units: About 108,000.

title: S. Rothschild & Co. Recalls Girls' Coats with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: Drawstrings on the detachable cape can pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 13,500.

title: Chairs Recalled by Brunswick Bowling & Billiards Corporation Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair frame can separate from the seating section of the chair, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,250 chairs.

title: Cummins Power Generation Recalls Portable Generators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Fuel can leak through the carburetor during normal usage, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 550.

title: Utility Snow Sled Hitch Recalled by Pelican International Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The screw(s) in the hitch can become loose and fall off due to vibrations when items are being towed, allowing the sled and hitch to detach from the towing vehicle. This poses an injury hazard to the user and bystanders. Units: About 250.
